title: After picking a hero the player is a green smiley orb, then invisible, for about 3 s before the class sprite appears
steps: Open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world&test=1&offline=1&seed=12345&heropick=1 at 1280x720
Click the first class card (Thicket Ranger)
Screenshot at +0.3 s, +1.5 s, +3 s, +6 s
expected: The chosen class sprite is drawn from the first frame (or the spawn pad shows a pixel placeholder of the class)
actual: +0.3 s: green orb with a face (code fallback) on the spawn pad at screen centre (640,350). +1.5 s: the spawn pad is EMPTY, no hero drawn at all. +3 s: the ranger strip appears. Before picking, the first realm render also shows flat colour terrain until tile art loads (art pop-in). Seen in all 3 runs (desk and phone).
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:270-300 (applyHero -> class strip load; the arena drops the fallback before the new strip has loaded) and shared/mm-art.js loadClass

title: World boss first appears as a pink cartoon devil face (code fallback) while its art lazy-loads
steps: Realm world test seed 12345, desktop
Walk (teleport) into the Godlands next to the Lich King site
Look at the boss in the first ~2 s after 'Lich King awakens!'
expected: Boss art is preloaded when the player nears a boss site, so the boss never shows a placeholder
actual: At (860,385) the boss is a 100 px pink circle with horns and a grin (emoji-like code fallback) for the first 1-2 s; later screenshots (and the phone run) show the b23 sprite. Very visible because it coincides with the 'awakens' banner.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:257-262 (boss art loaded lazily on first draw); preload when the player is within N tiles of world.bossSites

title: Ghost outline lines run parallel to terrain borders (water and sand), offset from the actual edge
steps: Realm world seed 12345, Shore zone near tile (0,119) or the start beach
Look at the water/shallow and dirt/sand borders
expected: One clean transition per terrain border
actual: A thin 2-3 px line (blue in water at ~(555-640,50-220), tan in the dirt band at ~(1020-1070,95-350)) traces the zone shape a few px away from the art edge, so every border has a double edge plus dashed dark squares along the sand edge. Looks like a code-drawn region stroke on top of the b10t edge tiles.

title: Highlands/Godlands: white snow patches drawn as frames with square holes; red lava areas are plus/cross blocks
steps: Realm world seed 12345, teleport to Highlands (tile 107,125) and Godlands (115,128)
actual: Snow/ice patches at (800-910,510-580) and (245-440,430-680) are white rectangles with regular 1-tile square holes, like a broken autotile mask; lava/red ground at top right (830-1000,0-210) is a hard-edged plus shape. Reads as a generator glitch, not terrain.
suspect: shared/mm-overworld.js patch generator + realm-world.js tile pick (art is R32, the hole pattern is code)

title: Town scale mismatch: Mayor statue and NPCs are 2-3x the player sprite, with mixed pixel density
steps: Join the Town offline at 1280x720 (nav-town.test.js pattern)
Walk up to the Hole / Postcards area
expected: One pixel scale for heroes, NPCs and statues (statue on a sculpted plinth)
actual: Player hero ~35 px tall at (660,330); Mayor statue ~80 px at (1015,490) with 3x chunky pixels on a flat grey rectangle plinth (code block, no outline/shading); paladin NPC ~65 px at (1180,435). Ladybug at (365,520) is as tall as the player. Mixed 1x/2x/3x pixel sizes on one screen.
suspect: game/main.js statue/NPC setScale; plinth drawn with graphics.fillRect

Look at the TOP SCORES board east of Postcards

title: Nexus plaza is a placeholder: flat checkerboard floor, rounded web box, big sans-serif labels

expected: Pixel plaza tiles, 8-bit frame and pixel font like the dungeons
